requirements.statement: When initiating a recurring CIT stored credential transaction, the transaction must be identified as 'R' (Recurring).
requirements.constraint_text: Transaction type = 'R'

requirements.statement: For recurring CIT stored credential transactions, CVV2 Data must not be sent.
requirements.constraint_text: Do not send CVV2 Data

requirements.statement: For recurring CIT stored credential, DE 111 Table 32 Sub Table 08 must be value 'I' (Initial).
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 32 Sub 08 = 'I'

requirements.statement: For recurring CIT stored credential, include CIT indicator via DE 111 Table 49 Sub Table 02 Value 'C'.
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 49 Sub 02 = 'C'

requirements.statement: For initial CIT recurring transactions, DE 111 Table 05 POS Entry Mode must be original POS Entry Mode value (e.g., 02, 90 as defined in Appendix J).
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 05 = original POS Entry Mode value

requirements.statement: For MasterCard CIT Standing Order (variable amount, fixed frequency) and Subscription (fixed amount, fixed frequency) transactions, merchant must send MIT/CIT category/subcategory in DE 111 Table 56 Sub Table 09.
requirements.constraint_text: Send MIT/CIT category/subcategory data via DE 111 Table 56 Sub Table 09

requirements.statement: For Visa, merchant must send Stored Credential Additional Data for Recurring payments for cards issued in India, using Data Element 111 Table ID 56 Sub Table IDs 01-13.
requirements.constraint_text: Send Stored Credential Additional Data via DE 111 Table 56 Sub Tables 01-13

requirements.statement: When initiating an installment transaction using a stored credential CIT, the transaction must be identified as 'I' (Installment).
requirements.constraint_text: Transaction identified as 'I' (Installment)

requirements.statement: When initiating an installment transaction using stored credential CIT, CVV2 Data must not be sent.
requirements.constraint_text: CVV2 Data must not be sent

requirements.statement: For installment CIT stored credential transactions, Data Element 111 Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 must have value 'I' (Initial).
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 32 Sub 08 = 'I'

requirements.statement: For installment CIT stored credential transactions, include Cardholder Initiated (CIT) indicator using DE 111 Table 49 Sub Table 02 Value 'C'.
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 49 Sub 02 = 'C'

requirements.statement: For installment CIT stored credential transactions, DE 111 Table 05 (Point-of-Service Entry Mode) must contain the original POS Entry Mode value (e.g. 02, 90 as defined in Appendix J) for the initial transaction.
requirements.constraint_text: Submit original POS Entry Mode value in DE 111 Table 05

requirements.statement: For MasterCard installment CIT transactions, merchant must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data via DE 111 Table 56 Sub Table 09.
requirements.constraint_text: Send MIT/CIT category/subcategory data in DE 111 Table 56 Sub 09

requirements.statement: When initiating a transaction using a stored credential CIT, POS Entry Mode value of '10' must be submitted in DE 111 Table 05.
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 05 POS Entry Mode = '10'

requirements.statement: For all card types on stored credential CIT transactions, DE 111 Table 32 Sub Table 08 must have value 'C' for Subsequent Credential on File.
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 32 Sub 08 = 'C'

requirements.statement: For stored credential CIT transactions, include CIT indicator via DE 111 Table 49 Sub Table 02 Value 'C'.
requirements.constraint_text: DE 111 Table 49 Sub 02 = 'C'

requirements.statement: For stored credential CIT (subsequent) transactions, CVV2 Data is optional.
requirements.constraint_text: CVV2 Data optional

requirements.statement: For MasterCard CIT unscheduled credential on file transactions, merchant must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data via DE 111 Table 56 Sub Table 09.
requirements.constraint_text: Send MIT/CIT category/subcategory in DE 111 Table 56 Sub 09

requirements.statement: In some TransArmor implementations, a longer Key ID and/or a Special device type can be specified using Segment 111, Table ID 52 â€“ Additional TransArmor Data.
requirements.constraint_text: Use Segment 111 Table ID 52 to specify longer Key ID and/or Special device type

requirements.statement: Participating merchant should send the Account Updater Request Indicator field (Variable Information segment 111, Table ID 060, Sub table ID 01) as trigger in request messages for all Instalment, Recurring, and Credential on File transactions.
requirements.constraint_text: Send Account Updater Request Indicator in Variable Information segment 111, Table ID 060, Sub table ID 01

requirements.statement: An incremental authorization request must contain the same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) as the estimated or initial transaction request.
requirements.constraint_text: Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) must equal estimated/initial request
